name: ai-kit
$comment: First matching rule wins; unmatched files are 'seed'. owned: kit-managed, refreshed on --update unless you modified them (then a .kit-new file is written). seed: created once, never touched again (docs, config, CODEOWNERS...). merge-doc: AGENTS.md (a differing existing file gets AGENTS.kit.md next to it). json-merge: settings merged additively; entries the kit previously shipped and later dropped are removed.
